//go:build js && wasm

package client

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// Pure helper vectors own their local value exclusively; only the final getter
// vector installs shared owner state, under offlineAuthorityMu.
func offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt() OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic {
	return offlineDiagnosticBeginLocked(OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic{},OfflineDiagnosticDisable,strings.Repeat("a",20),strings.Repeat("b",64))
}
func offlineDiagnosticTestACK(state, code string) OfflineDiagnosticACK {
	return OfflineDiagnosticACK{State:state,Error:code,Supported:true,RuntimeID:strings.Repeat("a",20),ConfigurationID:strings.Repeat("b",64)}
}
func offlineDiagnosticTestJSON(t *testing.T, d OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic) map[string]json.RawMessage {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.Marshal(d)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if len(raw) > OfflineRecoveryObservationLimit { t.Fatal("unbounded observation") }
	var result map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw,&result); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	return result
}

func TestOfflineRecoveryDiagnosticsUnknownIsNull(t *testing.T) {
	d := offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
	fields := offlineDiagnosticTestJSON(t,d)
	if len(fields) != 18 { t.Fatalf("closed header field count = %d",len(fields)) }
	for _, name := range []string{"update","unregister","register"} {
		var value map[string]json.RawMessage
		if err := json.Unmarshal(fields[name],&value); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		for _, key := range []string{"issued","returned","terminal","exactReceiver"} { if string(value[key]) != "null" { t.Fatalf("%s.%s fabricated known evidence",name,key) } }
	}
	var rpc map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(fields["disableRecovered"],&rpc); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if string(rpc["channelsCreated"]) != "null" || string(rpc["ack"]) != "null" { t.Fatal("unobserved channel became zero or ACK") }
}

func TestOfflineRecoveryDiagnosticsAdmissionRevisionWrap(t *testing.T) {
	previous := offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
	previous.DiagnosticRevision = ^uint32(0)
	d := offlineDiagnosticBeginLocked(previous,OfflineDiagnosticUpdate,previous.RuntimeID,previous.ConfigurationID)
	if d.DiagnosticRevision != 0 || d.Operation != OfflineDiagnosticUpdate || d.Coverage != OfflineDiagnosticCoverageUnknown { t.Fatal("admission revision did not wrap independently of coverage") }
	copy := d
	offlineDiagnosticFinishLocked(&copy,true)
	if d.LogicalReturned || !copy.LogicalReturned { t.Fatal("snapshot does not have value semantics") }
}

func TestOfflineRecoveryDiagnosticsUncertaintyCannotBecomeKnownZero(t *testing.T) {
	d := offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
	offlineDiagnosticFreshDisableCoverageLocked(&d)
	offlineDiagnosticNativeReceiptLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticMethodUnregister,false,true,false,true,OfflineDiagnosticNativeDispatchThrow)
	offlineDiagnosticFreshDisableCoverageLocked(&d)
	offlineDiagnosticNativeCoverageLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticMethodUnregister,true)
	if d.Coverage != OfflineDiagnosticCoverageUnknown || d.Unregister.Covered { t.Fatal("coverage was restored after unknown delivery") }
	fields := offlineDiagnosticTestJSON(t,d)
	var native map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(fields["unregister"],&native); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if string(native["issued"]) != "null" { t.Fatal("unknown native call became observed zero") }
}

func TestOfflineRecoveryDiagnosticsActualNativeOutcomes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, outcome := range []OfflineDiagnosticOutcome{OfflineDiagnosticResolvedTrue,OfflineDiagnosticResolvedFalse,OfflineDiagnosticResolvedOther,OfflineDiagnosticRejected} {
		d := offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
		offlineDiagnosticFreshDisableCoverageLocked(&d)
		offlineDiagnosticNativeReceiptLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticMethodUnregister,true,true,true,true,OfflineDiagnosticNone)
		offlineDiagnosticNativeTerminalLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticMethodUnregister,outcome)
		if d.Unregister.Issued != 1 || d.Unregister.Returned != 1 || d.Unregister.Terminal != 1 || d.Unregister.Outcome != outcome { t.Fatal("native result was fabricated or collapsed") }
	}
	d := offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
	offlineDiagnosticNativeCoverageLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticMethodUpdate,true)
	if d.Coverage != OfflineDiagnosticCoverageUnknown || d.Status.Covered { t.Fatal("UPDATE dispatch evidence claimed old RPC coverage") }
}

func TestOfflineRecoveryDiagnosticsFirstACKAndDeliveredDuplicates(t *testing.T) {
	d := offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
	offlineDiagnosticFreshDisableCoverageLocked(&d)
	offlineDiagnosticRPCReceiptLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticRPCDisableRecovered,true,true,true,true,OfflineDiagnosticNone)
	first := offlineDiagnosticTestACK("disabled","")
	offlineDiagnosticRPCEventLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticRPCDisableRecovered,OfflineDiagnosticTrustedEvent)
	offlineDiagnosticRPCValidReplyLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticRPCDisableRecovered,first)
	second := offlineDiagnosticTestACK("failed","client-capacity")
	offlineDiagnosticRPCEventLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticRPCDisableRecovered,OfflineDiagnosticTrustedEvent)
	offlineDiagnosticRPCValidReplyLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticRPCDisableRecovered,second)
	if d.DisableRecovered.ACK != first || d.DisableRecovered.DuplicateTerminals != 1 || d.DisableRecovered.TrustedEvents != 2 { t.Fatal("duplicate replaced first valid ACK or disappeared") }
	offlineDiagnosticRPCValidReplyLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticRPCDisableRecovered,second)
	if !d.Overflow || d.sanitized().Available { t.Fatal("duplicate saturation did not invalidate evidence") }
}

func TestOfflineRecoveryDiagnosticsLifecycleRequiresActualReturns(t *testing.T) {
	d := offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
	offlineDiagnosticFreshDisableCoverageLocked(&d)
	for _, event := range []OfflineDiagnosticRPCEvent{OfflineDiagnosticChannelCreated,OfflineDiagnosticListenerAdded,OfflineDiagnosticPortStarted,OfflineDiagnosticListenerRemoved,OfflineDiagnosticPort1Closed} {
		offlineDiagnosticRPCEventLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticRPCStatus,event)
	}
	if d.Status.Port2CloseReturned || !d.Status.Port1CloseReturned || d.Status.ListenerAdds != 1 || d.Status.ListenerRemoves != 1 { t.Fatal("one close return invented another resource terminal") }
	offlineDiagnosticFrameEventLocked(&d,true,true)
	offlineDiagnosticFrameEventLocked(&d,false,false)
	offlineDiagnosticFrameEventLocked(&d,false,true)
	if d.Frame.BalanceKnown { t.Fatal("later frame removal hid an unknown earlier removal") }
}

func TestOfflineRecoveryDiagnosticsClosedBoundsAndRegistry(t *testing.T) {
	d := offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
	offlineDiagnosticRegistryLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticRegistryFinal,false,true)
	if d.Registry.FinalAbsent { t.Fatal("unknown inventory became absence") }
	offlineDiagnosticRegistryLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticRegistryFinal,true,true)
	if !d.Registry.FinalAbsent || !d.Registry.FinalInventoryKnown { t.Fatal("actual absence was lost") }
	d.DisableRecovered.Terminal, d.DisableRecovered.BindingExact = true,true
	d.DisableRecovered.ACK = offlineDiagnosticTestACK("disabled",strings.Repeat("x",33))
	if d.sanitized().Available { t.Fatal("unbounded or open protocol error accepted") }
	d = offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
	d.RuntimeID = strings.Repeat("A",20)
	if d.sanitized().Available { t.Fatal("protocol identity was truncated or normalized") }
	d = offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
	for i := 0; i < 9; i++ { offlineDiagnosticRPCEventLocked(&d,OfflineDiagnosticRPCStatus,OfflineDiagnosticTrustedEvent) }
	if !d.Overflow || d.Status.TrustedEvents != 8 { t.Fatal("counter wrapped or exceeded finite bound") }
}

func TestOfflineRecoveryDiagnosticsSnapshotContainsOnlyScalars(t *testing.T) {
	var walk func(reflect.Type)
	walk = func(kind reflect.Type) {
		switch kind.Kind() {
		case reflect.Bool,reflect.String,reflect.Uint8,reflect.Uint32:
		case reflect.Struct:
			for i := 0; i < kind.NumField(); i++ { walk(kind.Field(i).Type) }
		default: t.Fatalf("snapshot contains forbidden %s",kind)
		}
	}
	walk(reflect.TypeOf(OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic{}))
}

func TestOfflineRecoveryDiagnosticsReadonlyCurrentOwnerCopy(t *testing.T) {
	d := offlineDiagnosticTestAttempt()
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	previous := documentOffline
	documentOffline = &offlineController{diag:d}
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	defer func() { offlineAuthorityMu.Lock(); documentOffline = previous; offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock() }()
	copy := OfflineRecoveryObservation()
	copy.DiagnosticRevision++
	copy.RuntimeID = "changed"
	actual := OfflineRecoveryObservation()
	if actual.DiagnosticRevision != d.DiagnosticRevision || actual.RuntimeID != d.RuntimeID { t.Fatal("readonly snapshot mutated owner or advanced admission") }
}
